transcript.answer: I found the threshold in the specs, not in code. I did not find the code constant itself. The spec `specs/temporal-fact-invalidation/spec.md` (FR-2.3) sets it as a cosine similarity of 0.92 by default. It can be overridden with the `LORE_FACT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD` environment variable. A new fact whose cosine similarity to an existing valid fact is at or above 0.92 invalidates the old fact and sets `valid_to` and `invalidated_by`. `specs/2-agent-memory/spec.md` also gives 0.92 and adds that a `fact_conflicts` row is written. The implementation is in `libs/server-core/src/work/memory/facts.ts`, and the specs cite `facts.test.ts` and `facts-extraction.test.ts` as validating tests.
